Package Cancellation Policy

Cancellation possible till 10 Oct*
After that package is non-refundable.

Till 10 Oct 26
₹14,250 Cancellation Fee
After 10 Oct 26
Non Refundable
These are non-refundable amounts as per the current components attached. If components change, the policy changes accordingly.
Please check the exact cancellation and date-change policy on the review page before proceeding further.
TCS once collected cannot be refunded on cancellation. You can claim it as an adjustment against income tax payable.
Cancellation charges are exclusive of all taxes; taxes will be added as applicable.
Package Date Change Policy

Date change possible till 10 Oct*
After that package date cannot be changed.

Till 10 Oct 26
₹12,000 Date Change Fee
After 10 Oct 26
Date cannot be changed
Date-change fee does not include any fare difference on the new date. Fare difference, if any, will be charged separately.
Date change depends on availability of the components on the newly requested date.
Please check the exact date-change policy on the review page before proceeding further.
Terms and Conditions

Simple terms that apply to this package.

Standard hotel check-in is 2:00 pm and check-out is 11:00 am. Early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability.
A maximum of 3 adults is allowed in one room. The third occupant is provided a mattress or rollaway bed.
The itinerary is fixed as per the day plan. Transfers are provided as per the itinerary and are not at disposal.
Flights, hotels and activities are subject to availability at the time of booking. Rates may change until confirmed.
